facts: NasFlightType extends core FlightType and appends assignedAltitude, flightPlan, interimAltitude, requestedAltitude among its extension sequence
NasHandoffEventType values are INITIATION, ACCEPTANCE, RETRACTION, TAKE_CONTROL, UPDATE, FAILURE
SfdpsFlightStatusType values are PROPOSED, ACTIVE, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, DROPPED
NasAltitudeType is a one-of choice among altitude forms
NasAltitudeType is an XSD choice; the parsed block and altFixAlt alternatives have named child sequences
AltFixAltAltitudeType declares point as fb:SignificantPointType followed by post and pre ff:AltitudeType values
BlockAltitudeType contains unqualified above and below children
NasHandoffType acceptingUnit is an unqualified child of type AtcUnitReferenceType

fields.constraint: bounded point codes and UTC XML dateTime values

valid_code subset and XML 1.0 character check; negative test

fields.declared_type: NAS acceptingUnit element is fb:AtcUnitReferenceType (abstract); emitted acceptingUnit xsi:type is the concrete fb:IdentifiedUnitReferenceType. Receiving/transferring use fb:IdentifiedUnitReferenceType.
fields.constraint: unitIdentifier and optional sectorIdentifier are preserved; bounded ASCII unit and sector values; acceptingUnit uses the official AtcUnitReferenceType

fields.enforced_by: format_time; fixed srsName; scaled_1e7; coordinate range checks; round-trip and negative test

fields.constraint: KNOTS is a permitted groundspeed measure; decimal quantities; model range 0..2000 kt for groundspeed and ±2000 kt for velocity
fields.enforced_by: fixed KNOTS output; range checks; negative test
constant output when field is present

limits: This is a finite encoder-profile inventory and its negative checks, not a general XSD processor.
The raw FIXM Core 3.0.1 XSD archive is pinned. The FAA NAS 3.0 extension is available here as official schema documentation/source extracts rather than as a retrieved raw XSD archive.
Fields absent from the model are not synthesized. Unmodeled SFDPS operational extensions are outside this encoder subset.

roundtrip_coverage: OA-FIXM-028 direct tests cover valid block and altFixAlt assignments, all six handoff event values with accepting/receiving/transferring units, and transferringUnit without an event.
OA-FIXM-028 emitted-child-order assertion includes assignedAltitude, flightPlan, interimAltitude and requestedAltitude.
OA-FIXM-028 route attribute tab, LF and CR are emitted as numeric character references so XML attribute normalization cannot alter decoded values.
